description: This source file implements the 'check-ref-format' command, which validates and normalizes Git reference names. It provides functionality to check whether a reference name complies with Git's naming rules, normalize reference names by collapsing redundant slashes, and handle special options like '--branch' for branch validation. The code interacts with Git's internal structures and functions, such as 'setup_git_directory_gently', 'check_branch_ref', and 'check_refname_format', to perform its operations.

methods.name: char * collapse_slashes(const char * refname)
methods.description: Normalizes a reference name by removing leading slashes and collapsing multiple adjacent slashes into a single slash.

methods.name: int check_ref_format_branch(const char * arg)
methods.description: Validates whether the provided argument is a proper branch name and extracts the branch reference.

methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments to check or normalize a Git reference name, supporting options like '--normalize' and '--branch'.
